audit.failure_rule: Gaussian p>=0.05; 5/5 truths within profiled Delta-chi2<=1; valid uncensored intervals
audit.projection: Gaussian exact-lattice; deterministic PNG finite-box continuum; inherited fixed stochastic projection adapter
audit.kmax_definition: cut on the two binned B000 legs; closing leg k3 is integrated and may exceed kmax

template_metadata.split: Gaussian Eisenstein-Hu ratio, Quijote fiducial, 8192 log nodes, 4-sigma kernel
